operations.title: Entry 1219 — The Physical Five-Site Marked Divisor Is Not Deck-Stable
operations.summary: The 26 positive physical marked sections are not stable under C2^5 sheet flips. Their signed orbit completion has 91 sections and character module 26 trivial plus multiplicity 9 for each single-edge character plus multiplicity 2 for each two-edge character, with no higher-weight characters. The positive chamber selects one non-invariant section per orbit; invariant averaging changes the physical divisor.

operations.title: Benincasa distinguishes the physical marked divisor from its deck-orbit completion
operations.body: Entry 1219 finds the physical 26-section positive divisor is not C2^5-stable. Its exact signed orbit completion has 91 sections with character content 26*1 + 9 sum_i chi_i + 2 sum_{i<j} chi_i chi_j, and no weight>=3 characters. The Euclidean chamber chooses one non-invariant section per orbit; averaging is canonical only after changing the divisor. This contrasts with Entry 1218's deck-trivial occurrence kernel. Next is the inclusion comparison between physical 26-section relative cohomology and the 91-section completion.
